rows.meaning: person who settles in a new country
rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who moves to another country to settle there.

example.english: My cousin is an immigrant in Canada and now lives in Toronto.
example.traditional: 我表哥移民咗加拿大，依家住喺多倫多。
